sources: Owner-approved Saraswati twin cities plan, 14 November 2026
name: Renu

lines.text: We build the thresholds high and leave the drains open. A pretty street that sends water indoors is a bad street.
Count the steps at the doors. The people who laid them knew how high the water could come.
A threshold and a channel are parts of one decision. A high door is little help if its water runs into the next house.
The work you helped us understand is keeping this place useful.
A pale wing above the sand, and no footmarks below it. Your account tells me more than a carving of a wing could.
Those bricks had another use before the plinth. We kept the sound ones and gave them work again.
